kurzbeschreibung: The Tiroler Volkskunstmuseum in Innsbruck showcases historic farmhouse parlours, traditional costumes, carnival customs, and masterly nativity scenes.
beschreibung:
Treasury of Alpine Living

Located right next to the Hofkirche in a former Franciscan monastery, the Tiroler Volkskunstmuseum invites visitors on an evocative journey through time. It is regarded as one of the most significant museums for folk culture and craftsmanship across the entire Alpine region, capturing the everyday life of past generations.

Historic Parlours and Living Traditions

Special highlights of the museum include more than a dozen authentic wooden parlours relocated from farmhouses and town residences. Alongside the celebrated nativity scene collection, the magnificent traditional costumes, ornate Fasnacht carnival masks, and vibrant folk arts from across all parts of Tyrol captivate visitors.
